summary: I work with ISVs and technology companies to build, modernise, and scale software products — with engineering teams that ship outcomes, not just code. As EVP of Product Engineering Services at Cybage Software, I partner with technology-enabled enterprises across payments, energy, cybersecurity, and SaaS platforms to solve the hard problems: legacy modernisation that doesn't break what works, cloud architecture that actually reduces operational risk, and AI integration that improves engineering velocity without sacrificing quality or accountability.

Three decades in software engineering have taught me one thing clearly — technology alone doesn't create impact. What creates impact is the combination of strong product thinking, disciplined engineering, capable teams, and measurable execution. That's what I build.
